approvalScope: Frozen JVM source/execution evidence and exact Root Swift draft-v1 cross-protocol source review. Swift SDK/JNI and authored regression execution remain pending.

crossProtocolConclusions.result: AnalyzeRule preUpdate guard retains the original exception type before null/BookSource/Book type returns. fromBookInfo skips refreshToc only; reGetBook continues. Same original WebBook precise name/author search and getInfo(false) execute inside parent coroutine context with original1800000ms max and stricter existing parent deadline. No old JSC/network substitution.

JVM sourceURL/fromBookURL/toBookURL/bookVariables/deadline/remainingTimeout fields match Swift Host whitelist, owner binding and opt-in TOC grant. Only internal coroutine provenance around the actual matched search conversion authorizes the hook. Normal unowned embedding has no App authority. Host checks exact task/source revision/current grant before ACK; public source text cannot mint the opaque native preview grant.

Host ACK occurs before persisted new-URL restore or any parent Book URL assignment. The matched SearchBook constructor suppresses only synchronous eager restore for the exact target URL and restores the ThreadLocal in finally; it neither broadens later storage keys nor opens another record. Rejected/mismatched ACK cannot mutate parent URL. Accepted grant is task-local, not durable App migration.

For normal putVariable and matched entries, RuleStateStore.update obtains the current persisted global short map and then clears/repopulates that same RAM map after each accepted CAS. authorize compares map contents, not raw Book.variable String, which can intentionally remain stale after a new long value. A second reGetBook captures the latest current URL and same synchronized map; no source-level desynchronization was found on this normal path. Native direct variableMap mutation is not broadened into a storage capability.

Swift holds the record at initial URL until a sealed successful TOC validates current URL and last accepted revision/hash. Large/chapter/TOC buckets remain URL-scoped in the same record; only the global short map follows original RAM merge semantics. Old entity+TOC snapshots are invalidated and also bind current URL. Successful swap retains identityBookURL as record-ID anchor, returns new TOCPackage.bookURL/context, and App BookStore checks old identity before updating bookInfoURL with existing UUID/progress.

Accepted grant followed by cancellation records its fact before JVM checks activity; JVM does not assign new RAM URL or continue target writes when cancellation is already observed. Swift rechecks cancellation/grant at ACK and sealed completion; rejected/failed/cancelled business cannot durably swap record URL. Actual previously accepted variable/compartment writes remain facts; neither side claims transaction rollback. Native effects and JVM granted marker are separate receipt facts through existing channels.

Host callback directly enters the already-owning service actor helper while its caller awaits original execution; it never reacquires the source operation gate or starts another JVM. The identity helper is synchronous actor-owned file/CAS validation, and matched construction suppression is synchronous, preventing the known source-gate reentry cycle.

RootQuestions.shortVariableCAS: No confirmed blocker on standard putVariable/matched-entry path; exact sync mechanics reviewed above. Multiple reGetBook has not been claimed as an executed new vector unless included in future SDK or JVM evidence.
RootQuestions.alternateMapRecursion: Outer Cursor.skipValue already bounds the entire nested JSON subtree to32 levels before recursive field navigation, so recursive alternateURLState cannot bypass depth protection or mint grants. Unknown nested fields would be ignored by PreviewURLState decoding and never used as authority. A one-level URLState-map helper/rejection of nested alternate is reasonable bounded cleanup/hardening, but no new confirmed privilege escape or unbounded recursion is asserted for draft-v1.

limits: Root five-source Swift production draft, four App and one Native regression are source-reviewed/authored only. No Swift parser/compiler/SDK/JNI execution occurred during this review.
